bulk_metadata.description: A JSON file containing all Oracle tags sourced from Tagger, the Scryfall community tagging project.
bulk_metadata.name: Oracle Tags

identity_notes: 32,138 unique top-level Oracle IDs. 71 additional reversible_card rows lack top-level oracle_id; both faces share one Oracle ID, already present among top-level IDs.
Join by top-level oracle_id when present; otherwise distinct nonempty card_faces[*].oracle_id. Preserve source row and parser-input identity separately.

raw_schema.tagging_note: annotation is optional; weight is a string; direct map preserves only explicitly assigned tag slugs, raw data preserves all fields

semantic_notes: Oracle tags include functional and non-functional/cycle tags; curated categories are heuristic selections.
Parent tags can have zero direct members; ancestor membership is derived from graph edges and must be labeled separately.
Tag presence suggests investigation clusters; it does not prove implementation correctness. Tag absence is unknown, not proof of absence.
Do not mix a failure in one ability with every card-level tag as if each tag caused the failure.
